metadata.name: Save a file from a web page
metadata.author: recued-core
metadata.description: Use “Save a file from a web page” in Recued. Save a file a page links to, such as a PDF or a spreadsheet, among your files, by its link (ref or CSS selector) or its address. Your server fetches a public file itself, up to 25 MB; one behind a sign-in comes as the page would fetch it, up to 2.5 MB. Answers its file ref, for reading a PDF or the CSV recipes.

ref.help: The ref of the link to the file, such as e12, from the latest inspection of this page. Leave it empty when passing a selector or the file's address.
ref.label: Link

page.help: The page's address, such as https://example.com/orders, whether a tab shows it or not: with none showing it, the page is opened in a new tab first, which asks you unless allowed on that site. Or a page handle a listing, an opening, a read or an action answered, copied exactly.
page.label: Page

address.help: The file's own http or https address, when you have it rather than a link on the page. Leave it empty when naming the link.
address.label: File address

selector.help: A CSS selector for the link to the file, such as a[href$=".pdf"]. Leave it empty when passing a ref or the file's address.
selector.label: Link selector
